summary: Voters in Rampur city mainly raise open drains (two child deaths reported), daily power cuts, a pipeline burst that cut water and flooded roads, and limited jobs, while crediting the ongoing railway station works and some improvement in security.

positives.english: Railway station work has started, with cold-water machines and extra tanks installed
positives.hindi: स्टेशन का काम शुरू, पानी की मशीनें और टंकियां लगीं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (Sambad, 10 Oct 2026): Rampur station is being modernised under Amrit Bharat, the booking window has moved to the new building, and the railway has installed chilled drinking-water machines and additional water tanks. The foot-overbridge quote is from Station Superintendent Mohammad Azam, not a voter. Amar Ujala (21 Jul 2026): foot-overbridge with lift, about Rs 23 crore under Amrit Bharat, construction started, no completion date given. It is under construction, not completed.

positives.english: Thefts have come down and security has improved
positives.hindi: पहले से चोरी कम हुई है, सुरक्षा बेहतर हुई है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026, reporter Vijay Singh Pundir, states interviews are in the Rampur Vidhan Sabha constituency): an unnamed citizen said thefts had decreased and security had improved. Paraphrased, single-voice view. No independent source found.

positives.english: Police are paying attention to women's safety
positives.hindi: पुलिस महिलाओं की सुरक्षा पर ध्यान दे रही है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026): an unnamed student said police were paying attention to women's safety. Paraphrased, single-voice view. No independent source found.

positives.english: Changes are visible over the last five years, including universities and women's empowerment
positives.hindi: पिछले पांच सालों में यूनिवर्सिटी और महिला सशक्तिकरण में बदलाव दिखे हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026): unnamed students said Rampur has changed over five years, citing the establishment of universities and a push for women's empowerment. Paraphrased. Weak positive: a general view, not a named project. No independent source found.

positives.english: Some good changes are visible in Jwala Nagar
positives.hindi: ज्वाला नगर में कुछ अच्छे बदलाव दिखे हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026): an unnamed student spoke of positive changes in Jwala Nagar, in the context of law and order and women's safety. The article gives no specifics (paraphrase). Weakest positive; single source.

negatives.english: Open drains are taking children's lives here, and covers are still missing
negatives.hindi: खुले नाले बच्चों की जान ले रहे हैं, ढक्कन अब भी नहीं लगे
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Rampur (Samvad, 20 Aug 2026): a child died in the drain at Nai Basti, which the article says is still uncovered. A second child, Aman of Ajitpur, died; drain covers removed with a JCB to recover his body were not put back. The article gives no ages. Mala Road drain is not fully covered, Shaukat Ali Road drain is wide and uncovered, and Swar Road drain is open. The EO said all drains had been covered but a team would be sent again. Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): the city has 84 drains and nallis, and blocked drains overflowed onto Shaukat Ali Road and Kachehri Road in heavy rain.

negatives.english: Power goes off for four to five hours every day, and complaints get no proper answer
negatives.hindi: रोज चार-पांच घंटे बिजली गुल रहती है, शिकायत पर ठीक जवाब नहीं मिलता
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Rampur (28 Feb 2026, Ramadan report): residents said power went off four to five hours a day in city areas including Pahadi Gate, Bareilly Gate in Shahabad, Civil Lines, Awas Vikas and Bilaspur Gate, and that they got no proper answer when they complained. SDO Irfan Ali blamed tree-trimming along lines; officials said Chinese manjha caught in the wires causes repeated faults, and supply would resume after repairs. Amar Ujala (27 Jul 2026) reports further outages in Qila, Shahabad Gate, Bareilly Gate and Jwala Nagar, including about two hours at Bareilly Gate and about two hours in Jwala Nagar.

negatives.english: A pipeline burst here, water was cut for two days and roads are flooded
negatives.hindi: पाइपलाइन टूटी, दो दिन से पानी बंद और सड़कों पर पानी भरा
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Rampur (Samvad, 30 Aug 2026): a damaged pipeline on the Kachehri Road to SBI Road route flooded roads and cut water supply for two days to the area, which the article puts at about 8,000 to 9,000 homes. Civil Lines to Gandhi Samadhi also had shortages. Repairs had not started two days after the damage was reported. EO Durgeshwar Tripathi said the damaged pipeline would be repaired. No completion is reported. Amar Ujala (22 Aug 2026): Kachehri Road, Roadways Workshop Road, Civil Lines and Jail Road were waterlogged within an hour of rain, with drain sewage on the roads.

negatives.english: Youth say talent is there but job opportunities here are limited
negatives.hindi: प्रतिभा है, पर यहां रोजगार के मौके सीमित हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala's Rampur election-issues report (2 Sep 2026), which states its interviews are in the Rampur Vidhan Sabha constituency: youth said jobs are the most important issue, that talent is not lacking but job opportunities are limited, and that Rampur, once known for factories, now lags on jobs. Reported indirectly, with no named speakers.

negatives.english: At the district hospital, ward boys are often missing and relatives have to pull stretchers themselves
negatives.hindi: जिला अस्पताल में वार्ड बॉय नहीं मिलते, स्ट्रेचर खुद खींचने पड़ते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (Samvad, 30 Sep 2026), Rampur district hospital: ward boys are often absent, so relatives pull stretchers and wheelchairs. Patients wait several days for ultrasound and CT tests. In a separate report the article carries, an internet failure of about three hours stopped online slip generation and long queues formed. AD Health Moradabad said relatives pulling stretchers was wrong and the CMS would be instructed to correct it. AC membership unconfirmed: the article does not state the hospital's location inside the AC, so this item is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

round2.changes: Opened and checked all 10 unique Amar Ujala URLs and the Wikipedia identity page. Removed the 27 Jul 2026 source from positive 5 (it supports a power-cut item, not a positive). Removed the unsupported dialysis claim from negative 5 (no source opened showed it). Corrected negative 2: 'Shahabad Gate' is 'Bareilly Gate in Shahabad' in the 28 Feb article, and the SDO's manjha point is an officials' statement. Corrected negative 1: child death locations and the drain-cover detail now match the 20 Aug article, and ages are not given. Corrected negative 5 internet detail to 'online slip generation'. Positive 1 Hindi shortened to 10 words; foot-overbridge marked as under construction. Positives 2-5 remain single-source (2 Sep 2026); about ten further Hindi and English searches found no independent, AC-specific delivered positive. Rejected: CM Yogi's 30 Jun 2026 102-project event (article places projects in Milak and Bilaspur constituencies, not Rampur city); 30 Aug 2026 plastic-free ponds (district-level, blocks named are Swar, Bilaspur, Shahabad, Milak, Chamraua, none confirmed inside this AC).

notes: Identity: Wikipedia's Rampur, Uttar Pradesh Assembly constituency page (fetched for this round) confirms constituency 37, district Rampur, reserved status None, and extent 'Panwaria & Rampur MB of Rampur Tehsil'. City localities named in the sources (Kachehri Road, Civil Lines, Shaukat Ali Road, Jwala Nagar, Shahabad Gate, Bareilly Gate and others) are counted as AC-specific because the Rampur MB is inside the AC; the sources do not state each mohalla's boundary. Field check needed: whether Nai Basti, Ajitpur and Mala Road are inside the MB. Positives 2 to 5 rest on one 2 Sep 2026 Amar Ujala article of indirect, paraphrased views from unnamed people. They are sourced but weak and do not represent a survey. Independent positives: none found for AC 37 city after about ten Hindi and English searches. Positive 1 is an official-side delivered-works item (station works; the foot overbridge is under construction and not counted as completed). Negative 3: the 30 Aug article reports the repair had not started; no completion is confirmed. Negative 5: the district hospital's location inside the MB is not stated in the source, so it is not counted. Excluded as outside this AC: Milak drain shop encroachment (8 Oct 2026, Milak is a separate constituency); the 15 Sep 2026 BKU power protest at the Ashoknagar 33 kV substation, dateline Bilaspur, about rural feeders; Rampur Bushahar and Rampur Naddi items (Himachal Pradesh) and Jaunpur. Sugarcane: no Rampur-specific cane dues or mill report found. Stray cattle: no Rampur crop-damage report found. Medical college and park projects: nothing found for Rampur city. Field checks: whether the Ashoknagar 33 kV rostering affects city feeders; current drain-cover status (the EO's claim is disputed by the article); status of the Civil Lines pipeline repair; Rampur district hospital dialysis status (not in any fetched source).
